authorization_scope: Public N0 voice-expression and prosody foundation teaching for A.L.I.C.E.; no Elaina-specific or private identity gradient
provenance_or_authorization: Owner explicitly stated that A.L.I.C.E. will be used mostly through voice and that the personality model must control tone and emotion efficiently. This shard teaches generic public spoken-expression operations needed before later Elaina-derived voice behavior is introduced under the private identity boundary.
purpose: Voice-first N0 foundation: five independent scenarios per spoken-expression competency so later Elaina-derived identity learning can control emotional and prosodic delivery rather than only lexical choice.
